gary_comparison_neuron_instance

One volume, one test block: the colleague's [4000, 5000)^3 corner of the hemibrain Ellipsoid Body crop, scored on its lattice-aligned 896^3 centre. Voxel metrics, not skeleton ones (dense labels, no skeletons): panoptic quality ranks; VOI split/merge, SQ, RQ and adapted Rand error are reported.

Post-processing is fitted on a 1000^3 block of the validation slab directly beneath the test corner (gary_comparison_fit.yaml), never on the test block. Models trained on lmd_ssl_v1's finetune set saw this volume's central 1024^3, which lies in the train and validation slabs, not in the test corner, so they may be scored here as well.

lmd_ssl_v1_neuron_instance

Voxel metrics, not skeleton ones: these volumes ship dense label arrays and no skeletons, so nERL is unavailable and panoptic quality ranks. Not comparable with any NISB nERL figure.

Scored region per volume is the largest lattice-aligned sub-box of each volume's bounding box, the same region the cc_threshold entries use, so the two are directly comparable.

Labels are 1..k with no background: mutex watershed assigns every voxel to a cluster. Ids were compacted at conversion because `_factorize` only takes its counting path while the id span stays under 2**31, and two of these volumes carried raw union-find root ids spanning 4.2 G and 7.06 G.

lmd_ssl_v1_zebrafish_instance

Voxel metrics, not skeleton ones: these volumes ship dense label arrays and no skeletons, so nERL is unavailable and panoptic quality ranks. Not comparable with any NISB nERL figure, nor with lmd_ssl_v1_neuron_instance, which averages four volumes per half.

One volume per half. The fit half is zebrafish_fish2_quadcube1 (4.247 G voxels scored), the reported half zebrafish_fish2_doublecube1 (7.078 G). Both sit on a 1920-cubed lattice at 8.0/8.0/8.027 nm, identical for all three arms -- verified from each artifact's own native_box, read_shape and effective_voxel_nm rather than assumed from the config.

Labels are 1..k with no background: mutex watershed assigns every voxel to a cluster. Ids are compacted at conversion because `_factorize` only takes its counting path while the id span stays under 2**31, and these two volumes carry raw union-find root ids spanning 4.2 G and 7.06 G.
